item.title: Medical malpractice reform bill heads to House floor in New Mexico
item.description: SANTA FE, N.M. (KRQE) – The bill to reform medical malpractice laws in New Mexico has made it to the House floor. House Bill 99 caps punitive damages that doctors must pay when sued for malpractice.
